Ama.reason: AMA is the acronym for the Any Match Accuracy metric, not a human language, so this is a false positive.

Mak.reason: mak is part of the transliteration mak.tab for an Arabic word meaning ‘office’, not a human language, so this is a false positive.

Arabic.reason: Arabic is the language whose morphology and morphological generation the YallaMorph benchmark constructs and evaluates.

English.reason: English is used as a prompt language and compared experimentally with Arabic prompts in the evaluation.
